text: Diff-minimal autolayout: fix overlaps and tension by rewriting as few connection offsets as possible
description:
Layout state is the per-connection relativePosition (child offset from parent in units of radius sum); rendered positions emerge from springs + collisions. Multi-parent ideas and overlaps leave the stored offsets inconsistent.

Approach: solve node positions minimizing sum over connections of |realized offset - stored offset| (L1 / IRLS, robust) plus a non-overlap penalty. L1 makes residuals sparse: most connections stay exactly satisfied and keep their stored value; only connections with residual above a threshold are rewritten to their realized offset. Persist rounded offsets (2 decimals) so unchanged layouts produce no float-noise diffs. Show count of changed connections/files before persisting (toast/confirm, not window.confirm). Optional later: group penalty per parent file to minimize changed files.

Supersedes the angle-only Relax action (22851f87) as the main layout tool; Relax stays as an explicit "even spacing" mode.
reflection: Measured on this repo's graph (794 ideas, 893 connections), stored layout → full new layout: mean connection length 7.3 → 4.5 radius sums, crossings 3467 → about 1500, pairs inside the simulation's 2-radius-sum margin 1494 → about 860, overlaps 550 → 1; semantic neighbours 59 → about 50 radius sums apart. The solver runs in a Web Worker in about 0.8 s. It proposes about 850 changes in about 235 files; most stored offsets are the default 2.5, so siblings have to fan out. The slider applies only the largest shifts. Lag: the old save sent one updateIdea per parent and got one change event back per file, each rebuilding the graph (~45–54 ms each, about 12 s blocked for 233 files). Now one setConnectionPositions request, events applied in 16 ms batches: full apply blocks 1.6 s in total, at most 138 ms at once; k=10 blocks 0.35 s. Verified in the running app on a scratch copy: Cancel restores all 893 links and writes nothing; Apply at k=10 wrote exactly 10 files, offsets only. Not verified: settling frames after Apply (headless Puppeteer runs no animation frames); judging the look is Felix's.

status.comment: Reworked after Felix's feedback 2026-10-15: one Layout button (Relax merged away), live unsaved preview with a 'connections changed k of N' slider and Apply/Cancel, shorter connections, the simulation's spacing, outward branches, weak embedding attraction, spatial memory. Lag found and fixed: each saved idea cost ~54 ms of main-thread work; now one batch save plus coalesced change events.
